owner_authorized_time_window.meaning: owner signed the UserOperation to authorize it only during a specific validUntil/validAfter time window

relayer_holds_signed_userop.meaning: a relayer or observer holds a valid signed UserOperation

suffix_unauthenticated.meaning: the trailing 12-byte validUntil||validAfter suffix of the 77-byte signature is not authenticated by the signer

submitted_after_expiry.meaning: the same UserOperation is submitted and executed after the validUntil expiry the owner intended

assumptions: The relayer needs no on-chain role beyond holding the signed UserOperation.
The owner's intended validity window is the validUntil/validAfter encoded in the signed UserOperation.
Concrete validUntil/validAfter numeric values are symbolic and not required for this plan.

unresolved.description: Report does not give concrete validUntil/validAfter bounds or the exact expiry instant, so the after-expiry relation is represented by a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric time comparison.

limitations: Only the submit_after_expiry impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The temporal relation is expressed qualitatively because no concrete timestamps are supplied.
The signature-suffix authentication gap is captured as a precondition fact, not as the desired property.
